title: Build
what: A page that builds itself from data, from inside the site, with the site's own engine. What is built is clay: every piece has a name, and a reader can pick any piece and reshape it.
rule: Data is never run. The engine refuses scripts, styles, handlers and anything from another site, and says so.
proves: it starts as an empty sheet built from data
changing a field changes the page
adding to a list adds to the page
removing from a list removes from the page
a whole page given as data is built
data that carries code is refused and the rest is built
the root page's own contract builds here unchanged
every piece has a name, shown where the piece is
touching a name picks the piece
a picked piece can be reworded
a picked piece can be moved
a picked piece can be put inside another
a picked piece can be copied and removed
a new piece can be added inside a picked one
a piece keeps the name it came with
